title: Orchestrate a Pipeline DAG
summary: Build the core of an orchestrator like Airflow: order tasks by their dependencies, detect cycles, group tasks that can run in parallel, and run a DAG with retries and upstream-failure propagation.

hints.test_topological_order_respects_dependen: Kahn's algorithm: count each task's unmet upstreams, start from tasks with zero, and as each finishes decrement its downstream tasks.
hints.test_topological_order_is_deterministic: When several tasks are ready, take the alphabetically smallest first. A heap (heapq) of ready tasks does this.
hints.test_cycle_is_detected: If Kahn's algorithm finishes before visiting every task, the leftovers are on a cycle. Raise ValueError.
hints.test_unknown_dependency_is_rejected: Validate up front that every upstream name is itself a task in the DAG.
hints.test_execution_layers: Each layer is every task whose upstreams all finished in earlier layers. Sort tasks within a layer.
hints.test_run_dag_success_order: Run tasks in topological order and record each one as 'success'.
hints.test_retries_recover_flaky_task: Call a failing task again, up to max_retries extra times. Attempts = 1 + retries used.
hints.test_failure_propagates_downstream: If a task fails for good, every task downstream of it becomes 'upstream_failed' and is never called.
hints.test_independent_branch_still_runs: A failure only blocks its own descendants. Tasks on other branches still run.
